# E2P Systems Group

> Equipment-to-Process Systems Group at the Korea Research Institute of Chemical Technology (KRICT), led by Han Sol Jung.

## Canonical site
https://dochi37-cpu.github.io/

## Research identity
E2P develops methods for translating equipment physics, performance and operating constraints into credible process and dynamic models, validated against engineering and demonstration evidence and used for design, scale-up, operation and deployment decisions.

## Current status
- Established at KRICT in August 2025.
- Current work focuses on e-SAF process-model credibility and system decisions, equipment reality and operability, and CO2-to-methanol demonstration-plant systems.
- E2P-originated publications and IP are labeled only after public release and defensible attribution.
- PI prior/collaborative publications and IP are explicitly distinguished from E2P-originated outputs.

## Public-data policy
The website does not disclose confidential plant data, pre-publication patent filings or unvalidated research conclusions.
